case: admits-clean: two rendered documents with no lint and no bound running
q0-refuses-an-absent-population: no documents key at all must not read as an empty body that admits
q2-refuses-the-marquee-binding: a finite animation binds running
withheld-beside-admitted-is-not-a-deny: a document the host could not render is withheld, the clean one beside it is judged

documents.withheld: a pinned host file is absent

case: null-withheld-does-not-fire: a null reason is not a withholding
all-null-case-is-withheld-only: lint and bound_running not measured are withheld by name, never a deny
null-qmllint-is-withheld: a null qmllint was not measured, it is not 'installed'

withheld: qmllint was not measured; Q1 cannot say whether it ran

case: withheld-without-qmllint: no qmllint on the host is withheld, not a deny

withheld: qmllint is not installed on this host; Q1 measured nothing
